title: Pure Chaos Comedy Presents: Best of Kansas City
price_label: $20 + taxes & fees online · $25 at the door
description: Six Kansas City comics, billed as the best of that scene, get one night on Essex Street with Tony Sloan hosting. Go to see a whole out-of-town scene in an hour; the room is 60 seats and dry with no minimum, so the $20 ticket is the whole price.

title: Magic City – A Night of Comedy
price_label: $20 + taxes & fees online · $25 at the door
description: DJ Hollywood Deuce and Fat Magic, self-billed “Baby Daddy of Comedy,” bring their Magic City showcase to a 60-seat dry room with no drink minimum. Go for a lineup from outside the usual downtown circuit at a price where $20 really is the whole night.

title: Laughing Lassi
description: A full bill of South Asian stand-ups from New York and beyond, at 7pm sharp on a Friday in Midtown. Go for a show built around one scene from top to bottom, early enough to leave the rest of the night open.

description: EngageBX’s Halloween show is free, food and drinks included, with Imagine headlining and Simeon Goodson, Nicky Sunshine and Sofia Angeron on the bill; Sashalyn Medina hosts. A named lineup uptown at no cost is the reason to go. Space is limited, so RSVP early.

title: Michael Pasvar & Friends
price_label: $20 + taxes & fees online · $25 at the door
description: Michael Pasvar produces and hosts, with Michael Burnett and Joe Manning, in the 60-seat dry room on Essex Street. Go for a three-comic bill in a small room, and with no drink minimum the $20 ticket is the whole price.

title: Mark Simmons: Jest to Impress
description: Mark Simmons, the British one-liner comic whose gag won Dave’s Funniest Joke of the Fringe in 2024, brings a new hour to SoHo Playhouse for a short run through Oct 28. Go for sixty minutes of built jokes from one writer instead of a showcase, and you are out by 8.

title: Christian Finnegan
price_label: See Comic Strip Live ticket page for price
description: Christian Finnegan gets the Monday bill at Comic Strip Live, which is marking 50 years on Second Avenue. Go to see a veteran headliner in one of the city’s original club rooms on a quiet night; budget for the two-item minimum.

title: Comedy Spotlight: Chris Distefano & Mark Normand
price_label: See Gotham Comedy Club ticket page for price
description: Gotham’s Tuesday Comedy Spotlight bills Chris Distefano and Mark Normand “and more.” Two theater-level names in a club room on a weeknight is the reason to go; lineups can change, tables are shared and there is a two-beverage minimum.

title: Drew Lynch, Esther Povitsky & Jack Finnegan
venue: New York Comedy Club (Upper West Side)
description: Drew Lynch and Esther Povitsky share a five-comic bill with Jack Finnegan, Mary Santora and Alex Babbitt at the Upper West Side room. Go for two touring names on a $15 ticket; the club’s $20 minimum is on top.

title: Farooq Hussain Presents: Lasergooch!
description: Farooq Hussain’s Lasergooch! puts him on a bill with the duo Greg and Rob, Sima Sepehri and Alexis Cristaldi. Go for a comic-run night with its own name and point of view; seating is first come and there is a two-drink minimum.

title: Dina Hashem, Greg Melly, Napoleon Emill & Sharief Johnson
price_label: $33.46 general admission ($30 + $3.46 service fee); $44.11 front row
description: Dina Hashem, seen on Comedy Central’s Roast Battle and Conan, headlines the 10pm Saturday show with Greg Melly, Napoleon Emill and Sharief Johnson. Go for a dry, exact joke writer with a late crowd; two-drink minimum.

title: Rudy Rush & Friends: Birthday Comedy Show
price_label: $25 plus $18 food & drink minimum per person
description: Rudy Rush, the former Showtime at the Apollo host, throws himself a birthday show, and the club says of the “friends” that you never know who might walk in and grab the mic. Go for a host’s party uptown; there is an $18 food and drink minimum.

title: Matt Goldich with Ryan Beck, Ismael Loutfi & Vannessa Jackson
description: Matt Goldich, a longtime Late Night with Seth Meyers writer who has done stand-up on the show, headlines a Sunday bill with guests. Go to hear a monologue writer work at full length; doors are an hour early.

title: We Have Fun
description: Zach Sims and Dan Wilbur host their free Wednesday stand-up show in the back room at Young Ethel’s. Go because it costs nothing, with no minimum, and it is a real bar show; be there for 7:15 doors, the room fills.

title: Bomb Shelter Comedy
description: The Thursday edition of the no-cover, no-minimum show at The Gaf West, which bills comics seen on Comedy Central, The Late Show, Conan and Netflix. Go because a free show in Hell’s Kitchen with credits like that is the easiest yes of the week.

title: Bitches' Brew
description: Naomi Karavani, Sabeen Sadiq, Blair Dawson and Andrea Allan’s Friday stand-up and variety show in Halyard’s back room, free to get in. Go for a long-running producer-led bar show at no cost, a block from the Gowanus venues.

title: Faculty Lounge
price_label: Ticketed · $5 off before day of show
description: Amelia Hancock, Antoine Lee, Jonnea Herman and Bruce Terry are on this Sunday’s bill, hosted by Shalewa Sharpe, Maggie Crane and JoAnn Schinderle. Go for a posted lineup in a 35-seat room; tickets are $5 off before the day of the show.
